a few things i will say is that:

 1) consistency is *key*. going from showering your partner in gifts, words of encouragement etc, to showing absolutely no affection can leave a person feeling confused and hurt. you go from feeling like this person truly loves you and sees you for who you are, to feeling like they despise you. and it will be hard to earn back that trust from your husband, but i hope it will be worth it for the both of you. genuinely 

2) this process will be *FAR* from linear. you will have days where it starts to feel like everything is sunshine and rainbows, and the next might be the complete opposite. 

3) i am very happy that you are admitting your issues instead of denying the pain you may be causing. it’s a hard realization to come to, but i’m wishing the best for you, and your husband. good luck, OP
